clips.title: The story
paras: At Zoram'gar Outpost, Warsong Runner Update carries reports from western Ashenvale to Kadrak.

The Warsong runner at Zoram'gar Outpost watches the coast and nearby threats in western Ashenvale. The dispatch records observations gathered by scouts at the outpost and reports on local activity. It travels to Kadrak's watchtower on the Barrens border, helping Horde leaders strengthen their position and plan their movements into the elves' ancestral woods.
